answer: Similarity pooling at settle. Before payout, embed every passed answer and link any pair above 0.92 cosine; each linked cluster splits one reward, so ten clones pouring one template into the same canyon of near-identical text earn what a single honest author does. The threshold is published a close ahead, a flagged author can appeal with a public diff showing overlap under 0.80, and every close posts a pulse of cluster counts. Like karst, the cost sits under the surface until a farm scales and the ground gives way.
